0|51454ea42c1ab4e0c2828bb0d4d53957976980de|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"ipv6: fix locking issues with loops over idev->addr_list
idev->addr_list needs to be protected by idev->lock. However
always possible to do so while iterating and performing actions on
inet6_ifaddr instances. For example
addrconf_{join
column2: leave}_anycast) eventually call down to other functions

column1: that acquire the idev->lock. The current code temporarily unlocked the
idev->lock during the loops
column2: which can cause race conditions. Moving the

column1: locks up is also not an appropriate solution as the ordering of lock
acquisition will be inconsistent with for example mc_lock.
This solution adds an additional field to inet6_ifaddr that is used
to temporarily add the instances to a temporary list while holding
idev->lock. The temporary list can then be traversed without holding
idev->lock. This change was done in two places. In addrconf_ifdown
list_for_each_entry_safe variant of the list loop is also no longer
necessary as there is no deletion within that specific loop.
